editorial_review.viewer_question: How can I use the new GPT-6.2 Chat experience to compare two hotel options without missing important details?
editorial_review.prerequisites: An eligible Plus, Pro, Business or Enterprise ChatGPT account and non-sensitive hotel screenshots or details.
editorial_review.central_task: Compare two hotel options against a fixed list of priorities, and identify claims to verify before booking.
editorial_review.new_capability: November 23 rollout of a GPT-6.2 Sol version tuned for the Chat tab, with provider-reported gains in complex instructions, image questions and web research.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: November 20 covered GPT-6.2 Astra in ChatGPT Work for a checkable Excel workbook. This episode concerns the separate Chat tab rollout and an everyday visual comparison.
editorial_review.meaningful_delta: A different Chat experience reaches eligible paid users; the model improvement is an OpenAI claim, not an independently measured gain in this video.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: Turn two hotel screenshots and personal priorities into a side-by-side checklist, then verify rates and policies on the hotels' own pages.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented walkthrough using OpenAI release notes and image-input instructions; no live product test.
editorial_review.alternatives: Gemini Tasks calling has narrower geography and an older event date. Transformers 5.24 is a builder release needing setup review.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: The November 23 Chat rollout is recent, globally rolling out on eligible paid plans, and serves an everyday decision distinct from the prior Work/Astra video.
editorial_review.search_query: ChatGPT GPT-6.2 compare hotel options screenshots
editorial_review.availability_limitation: Rollout and plan/admin eligibility vary. Image reading and web findings can be wrong; confirm prices, cancellation terms and availability on hotel sites. No live test was run.
